title: US envoys to meet Putin, Zelensky after war talks in Abu Dhabi

blocks.text: DUBLIN, Ireland — US envoys will separately meet Russia’s Vladimir Putin and Ukraine’s Volodymyr Zelensky on Thursday as they seek to capitalize on “openings” from two days of talks in Abu Dhabi on ending the war in Ukraine. Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will travel first to Moscow to meet the Russian president before flying to Dublin, where Zelensky will attend European meetings, to brief the Ukrainian leader. Arriving in Ireland, Zelensky said there could be a “window of opportunity” to end Europe’s worst conflict since World War II before 2027.
